issues.title: Curved vector paths
issues.why: Curves are flattened to straight segments, so round shapes look faceted.
issues.fix: Use ellipses and rectangles with corner radius where you can. Import icons as images, or redraw the curves in Rive.

issues.title: Radial, angular and diamond gradients
issues.why: Only linear gradients are converted. These import as a solid colour (the first stop).
issues.fix: Use a linear gradient, or recreate the gradient in Rive after import.

issues.title: Frames without auto layout
issues.why: Their children are placed by position, so they import as fixed boxes and will not reflow when the content or size changes.
issues.fix: Select the frame and press Shift+A to add auto layout, then set direction, gap and padding. Ignore this for illustrations that should stay fixed.

issues.title: Background blur (frosted glass)
issues.why: Background blur is not supported in Rive.
issues.fix: Fake it with a semi-transparent fill, or add a blurred copy of the background image.

issues.title: Blend modes
issues.why: Blend modes (LINEAR_DODGE) are not converted, so the layer blends normally.
issues.fix: Flatten the effect into the colours, or set the blend mode again in Rive.

issues.title: Dashed strokes
issues.why: Dash patterns are not converted; the stroke imports solid.
issues.fix: Add a dash effect to the stroke in Rive after import.

issues.title: Layers with default names
issues.why: Layer names become names in the Rive hierarchy and are how scripts and state machines find things.
issues.fix: Rename the layers you plan to animate or script (for example "Avatar", "Submit button").

issues.title: Shadows with spread
issues.why: Shadow spread is ignored; the shadow imports at the layer's own size.
issues.fix: Set spread to 0 and adjust blur and offset, or use a larger shape under the layer.

issues.title: Fractional sizes
issues.why: Sizes like 10.667 come from scaled or fill-resized layers and can cause blurry edges.
issues.fix: Round sizes to whole pixels (Figma: select layers → Shift+Alt+drag, or type clean numbers).

issues.title: Clip content with a shadow
issues.why: Clipping would cut the shadow off, so "Clip content" is switched off for these frames.
issues.fix: If content spills outside the frame, resize or mask it in Figma first.

issues.title: Inside/outside strokes with a shadow
issues.why: These cannot be combined (the clip would cut the shadow), so the stroke is drawn centred.
issues.fix: Use a centre stroke, or put the shadow on a separate rectangle underneath.

issues.title: Component instances are detached
issues.why: Instances import as ordinary layout; they stay linked to nothing, so editing the component later will not update them in Rive.
issues.fix: The main component is also added as a Rive component artboard you can reuse.

issues.title: 2 font files to supply
issues.why: Rive does not read fonts from Figma, so each font and weight needs a .ttf file: Geist-SemiBold.ttf, Geist-Medium.ttf.
issues.fix: Put the files in the helper's fonts-library folder (or the project's fonts folder) using exactly these names. Without them a stand-in font is used.
